title: A Promise for the Vow
author: Dominic Zhou
blurb: Paloma Eriksen, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
